::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[A good memorandum template for LaTeX](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5479/a-good-memorandum-template-for-latex), asked by [Rook](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/18045/rook) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-16; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> Pretty much the title says it all ... does anyone know of a good memorandum template (with an example maybe?).
>
> You know, the things companies print on their text and stuff before faxing them out. It is usually composed of a letterhead on top (a logo on the left is optional), and some accounts and banking data in small letters on the bottom of the document.
>
> In the middle, goes your text.
>
> I'm rather unexperienced in composing LaTeX documents, but I have to make a memo and want it to look rather nice, so bear with me, if something in here sounds silly.
>
> Examples: 
>
> ![Juniata College letterhead][q-1]
>
> ![Brockhouse letterhead][q-2]
>
>
>   [q-1]: 589RL.jpg
>   [q-2]: miCRf.gif
:::

Do you have an example you're emulating that you can point out?  Googling "latex fax cover sheet" found [this page](http://www.dsl.org/comp/templates/) with a plain TeX template but I'm not sure if the template classifies as "rather nice."

This might be a good application of ConTeXt here.
